flashpoints.counterweight: Also dollar-positive in the short run, which works against gold. The net effect is genuinely ambiguous and often small.
flashpoints.typical_duration: Weeks, when it changes the inflation outlook. Announcement headlines alone rarely stick.
flashpoints.escalation_markers: Rates above expectations, retaliation, or extension to critical minerals and energy.
